items.name: theme
items.title: EDS theme (setmore-black)
items.description: Earth Design System colours and radius as shadcn theme variables. Install this first; every @eds component and plain shadcn component then looks like EDS.
items.docs: Values come from the EDS setmore-black brand tokens (background-accent #111111, text-secondary #676767, border-input #dbdbdb, background-critical #c44c44). Font is Inter (EDS body and heading font); EDS apps load it from @adaptavant/eds-fonts, other apps fall back to the system sans-serif.

items.name: button
items.title: Button and IconButton
items.description: EDS Button on shadcn structure: variant accentPrimary | accentSecondary | neutralPrimary | neutralSecondary | neutralSecondaryIntense | neutralTertiary | criticalPrimary | criticalSecondary | criticalTertiary | inversePrimary, size small | standard | large | xLarge, iconStart/iconEnd, isLoading, isDisabled, isPressed.
items.docs: Use accentPrimary for the main action on a surface and neutralSecondary or neutralTertiary for the rest. Pass icons as components: <Button iconStart={Plus}>New</Button>. IconButton needs an aria-label.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: EDS Tooltip API (content, placement, delay, maxWidth) with Radix Tooltip behaviour.
items.docs: Wrap one focusable element: <Tooltip content="Today"><Button>Today</Button></Tooltip>. Content is plain text only.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown menu
items.description: EDS DropdownMenu parts (DropdownMenuTrigger, DropdownMenuPopover, DropdownMenuItem with railStart/railEnd, isSelected) on Radix. onClick returning false keeps it open; isOpen/onOpenChange make it controllable.

items.name: time-picker
items.title: Time picker
items.description: EDS-only component moved into the registry. Interval, 12/24h format, min/max and a subtle variant, on Radix Popover. Controlled with value/onChange (minutes from midnight), which fixes the eds-core TimePicker limitation.
items.docs: Values are minutes from midnight: <TimePicker label="Start" value={570} onChange={setStart} interval={30} />. Use variant="subtle" inside dense forms.
